scope: Read-only review of the manual-judgment aggregator while training is live. No frozen file edits and no model calls.
verdict: No correctness blocker found in the inspected aggregator.

findings.strict_concern_pass: Requires production parse, nonempty findings, a genuine issue, all findings grounded, and all material claims supported=True. Genuine-issue validation separately requires grounded reason and causally appropriate citation. None or false material-claim support fails.
findings.clean_pass: Requires production parse and empty findings, matching the frozen clean-review rule. Empty parsed responses cannot carry genuine-issue or grounded-reason flags.
findings.unsupported_claims: Any explicit unsupported_claims entry requires all_material_claims_supported=False, preventing full concern pass while retaining genuine detected issues separately.
findings.genuine_vs_complete: genuine_issues_detected counts concern cases with a manually supported issue. Complete reviews additionally require parse/schema/citations and no unsupported material claims or findings.
findings.citation_alternatives: No exact gold wording, canonical line_id, expected_line_ids equality or structural reference-line-set flag gates semantic full pass. Production citation availability and manual causal appropriateness govern it.
findings.counts: Six fixed cohorts total176rows. Exactly176unique manual(arm,cohort,id)keys are required, each consumed key must exist, and final used==judgments equality rejects missing coverage. Given fixed176rawrows, any repeated rawcase would leave a unique judgment unconsumed and fail. Each summarized pair must contain exactly one concern and one clean.
findings.subsets: Retained14pairs, nested6same-diffpairs and12newquartetpairs are reported separately from the complete training cohort; their counts are not summed as independent cases.
findings.contrasts: Each family requires all four semantic/shape cells. Within-shape success requires both full reviews; across-shape success likewise requires both full reviews, with raw presence and sampled decision agreement separately reported. Malformed presence comparisons remain null.
findings.hashes: Generation summary binds the frozen plan; every source hash in its manifest is checked against disk. Manual notes bind model,prompt,response and trace hashes for each matched record. Raw response hashes and structural/raw parse-presence consistency are checked, and all read evidence appears in result.sources.
findings.manual_evidence: The aggregator validates and counts explicit manual notes. Semantic support is supplied by those complete-response readings; this audit examined aggregation logic before the final176notes are available.
findings.manual_fragment_closure: The combined notes require a nonempty sources list. Each referenced fragment is read through the provenance-recording read function and its SHA must match the binding. Every fragment case must equal the combined case dictionary exactly, duplicate (arm,cohort,id) keys across fragments fail, and the fragment-key union must equal all176combined judgments. Reading fragments records their bytes/SHA in final result.sources, preserving the individual readings in source closure.
